notes.title: Still Alive! Game Balance Update v1.01
notes.notes:
It's been a while!
Here's a small update changing a few of the starting abilities to make your initial attempts a bit easier!


Balance Changes:

 Reduced Grappling Hook cooldown and increased speed by a small amount
 Increased normal Jump strength by a small amount
 Reduced Dash cooldown
 Removed Spike Death Trap Punishment from Level 1 & 2, shortened Duration in other levels


Updated

 Added new music to Main Menu and almost all Levels


GL & HF!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.7
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42815708/f96fe9d877d1d45a8e8e557fc70910d3d2bd1412.jpg
Improvements:

 Made quite big changes to the movement and physics of the characters as well as the environment
 Overall the game is now a tiny bit less colorful and color coded to easier differentiate things on the screen, blue = not deadly/could be helpful, red = don't touch (excluding platforms, for which it means: can be destroyed), this is also reflected on most mini map icons
 Improved the collider of the mine ability, making it more reliable to stand on
 Adjusted some mini map icon colors and added an icon for speed boosts


Fixed:

 Fixed some bad textures
 Fixed some more minor issues
